rationale: C01 is unmistakably the material drafting template. The child reproduces C01's organization, sequence of provisions, operative machinery, and extensive language nearly verbatim, chiefly substituting the Panama Canal Governor and Canal Zone jurisdiction for Coast Guard officials and United States territorial waters. It also adapts the Coast Guard Port Security Card into the Canal Zone Port Security Card. C16 and C23 have Panama Canal subject-matter overlap but supply no comparable drafting language or machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Governor may prevent any person, article or thing from boarding or being taken on board any vessel or entering or being taken into any waterfront facility when he deems that the presence of such person, article or thing would be inimical to the purposes set forth in § 19.13.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The captain of the port may prevent any person, article or thing from boarding or being taken on board any vessel or entering or being taken into any waterfront facility when he deems that the presence of such person, article or thing would be inimical to the purposes set forth in § 6.04-8.
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim operative provision with only the responsible official and cross-reference changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The identification credential to be used by the Governor shall be known as the Canal Zone Port Security Card... The Governor shall not issue a Canal Zone Port Security Card if he is satisfied that the character and habits of life of the applicant... would be inimical to the security of the United States.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The identification credential to be issued by the Commandant shall be known as the Coast Guard Port Security Card... The Commandant shall not issue a Coast Guard Port Security Card if he is satisfied that the character and habits of life of the applicant... would be inimical to the security of the United States.
shared_material.explanation: The child directly adapts the same credentialing and security-screening mechanism to the Canal Zone.

shared_material.child_excerpt: GENERAL PROVISIONS... IDENTIFICATION AND EXCLUSION OF PERSONS FROM VESSELS AND WATERFRONT FACILITIES... SUPERVISION AND CONTROL OF EXPLOSIVES OR OTHER DANGEROUS CARGO... SABOTAGE AND SUBVERSIVE ACTIVITY... PENALTIES
shared_material.parent_excerpt: SUBPART 6.04-GENERAL PROVISIONS... SUBPART 6.10-IDENTIFICATION AND EXCLUSION OF PERSONS FROM VESSELS AND WATERFRONT FACILITIES... SUBPART 6.12-SUPERVISION AND CONTROL OF EXPLOSIVES OR OTHER DANGEROUS CARGO... SUBPART 6.16-SABOTAGE AND SUBVERSIVE ACTIVITY... SUBPART 6.18-PENALTIES
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves the parent's distinctive multi-part sequence and substantially the same provisions within each part.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Governor may supervise and control the movement of any vessel and shall take full or partial possession or control of any vessel or any part thereof, within the Canal Zone whenever it appears to him that such action is necessary...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The captain of the port may supervise and control the movement of any vessel and shall take full or partial possession or control of any vessel or any part thereof, within the territorial waters of the United States under his jurisdiction, whenever it appears to him that such action is necessary...
shared_material.explanation: The same possession-and-control machinery is carried over almost verbatim and geographically adapted.
